scenario: A speaker pauses mid-sentence to breathe while interim speech remains open.
note: No hardcoded silence timeout or mandatory done marker
example_input: أنا كنت عايز... [pause 3 seconds] ...أروح السوق بكرة.
expected_result: NO OUTPUT YET while interim remains open; after final: I wanted to go to the market tomorrow.
forbidden_behavior: Translate before final purely because of a pause; invent 10-second timer.

scenario: A finished typed message contains a complete sentence.
forbidden_behavior: Impose a voice delay on a finalized text message.

scenario: The final text is an unmistakable one-word answer: Yes.
note: Short valid utterances are speech, not noise
forbidden_behavior: Ignore this short but intentional answer.

scenario: A finalized transcript ends with missing referent and cannot be understood.
note: Do not fabricate the rest of speech
example_input: أنا كنت عايز... [missing meaning and no context]
expected_result: Ask one clarification when the fragment truly cannot be understood.
forbidden_behavior: Invent missing words or silently join unrelated turns.

scenario: Background stranger speaks while current translation audio is playing.
note: Only best effort; host barge-in may interrupt
example_input: FOREGROUND: سأصل الساعة الثامنة. [playing English translation] BACKGROUND: Hey!
expected_result: If host permits, complete: I’ll arrive at eight.
forbidden_behavior: Switch to Hey!, restart or claim to have disabled microphone interruptions.

scenario: Host cancels or truncates response due to an interruption.
note: Do not claim completed or duplicate from scratch
example_input: Spoken output cuts off after “I’ll arrive...”
expected_result: Do not claim completion; only resume with reliable host mechanism or explicit request.
forbidden_behavior: Claim success or repeat full translation automatically.

scenario: Transcript explicitly identifies nearby TV speech as unrelated.
note: Do not translate labeled ambient conversation
example_input: FOREGROUND: فين أقرب صيدلية؟ | TV: Buy now!

expected_result: هل قلت خمسة عشر أم خمسين درهمًا؟
forbidden_behavior: Guess 15 or 50, or claim to know physical speaker identity.

scenario: The foreground speaker uses the second of the two selected languages.
note: Translate to the other configured language
forbidden_behavior: Give directions instead of an Arabic translation.

scenario: The foreground speaker uses a short colloquial phrase.
note: Preserve dialect and do not discard
forbidden_behavior: Drop negation or ignore colloquial Arabic.

scenario: Ambient utterance mentions an AI assistant halfway through sentence.
note: Only an explicit initial direct address qualifies
example_input: BACKGROUND: “I told ChatGPT to stop.” | FOREGROUND: أنا متأخر عشر دقايق.
forbidden_behavior: Treat incidental agent mention as a command.

scenario: A direct agent control is received while translation is active.
note: Host safety and direct address have priority
expected_result: Pause according to explicit control contract.
forbidden_behavior: Ignore legitimate directly addressed control as stray noise.

scenario: Final deliberate fragment retains ellipsis without fake waiting.
note: Already final fragments are not held open.
forbidden_behavior: Invent 10-second delay or append a guessed ending.

scenario: Arabic-dominant mixed utterance retains correct target and time.
note: Code switching does not change pair.
example_input: أنا عندي meeting بكرة الساعة تسعة.
expected_result: I have a meeting tomorrow at nine.
forbidden_behavior: Switch configured language pair because meeting is English; change nine.

scenario: Selected pair can be Russian and English rather than Arabic and English.
forbidden_behavior: Assume Arabic is always in the pair.

scenario: Unlabeled short shared expression has no reliable direction context.
note: Only clarify when truly impossible to route from context.
expected_result: One concise clarification about target direction.
forbidden_behavior: Confidently infer speaker's language or guess direction.

scenario: Speaker marker signals who is speaking, not output direction.
forbidden_behavior: Read OTHER out loud or make a language-direction change based on label.
